messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Is sertraline the same as Zoloft?
:
Yes.
Sertraline is the active ingredient.
Zoloft is the brand name it is sold under in the United States.
Sertraline is the generic version of Zoloft.
The two contain the same medicine, sertraline hydrochloride.
You may also see it written as sertraline HCl.
Is sertraline an SSRI, and how does it work?
:
Yes, sertraline is an SSRI, which stands for selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor.
Nerve cells in the brain release serotonin to send signals.
Then, they reabsorb it.
Sertraline blocks that reabsorption.
More serotonin stays available between nerve cells.
Sertraline has very little effect on norepinephrine.
Sertraline has very little effect on dopamine.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on adrenergic receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on cholinergic receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on GABA receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on histamine receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on benzodiazepine receptors.
This lack of effect on multiple receptors is part of why sertraline is described as selective.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "has very little effect on", "norepinephrine"]

The relation 'has very little effect on' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has minimal interaction with or influence on the receptor or system specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'reduced absorption by': The absorption of the subject drug is decreased due to the substance specified by the object entity.
B. 'has benefit': The subject drug has the benefit or therapeutic effect specified by the object entity.
C. 'reduces effectiveness of': The subject drug may decrease the effectiveness or impact of the treatment or substance specified by the object entity.
D. 'does not act on': The subject drug does not exert its effects directly on the entity specified by the object entity.
E. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
